commit 943061e2742c16762cbe826747825e02d232ecce
Author: Prashant Khoje <prashant.khoje@neurealm.com>
Date:   Thu Jan 29 22:15:28 2026 +0530

    ppc64le - Fix deviation in floating point values caused by FMA (#91)
    
    This was exposed while testing CockroachDB.
    Following tests from pkg/sql/opt/exec/execbuilder fail due to floating point precision differences caused by FMA:
    - TestExecBuild/local/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/local-vec-off/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/local-spec-planning/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-vec-off/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-metadata/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-disk/geospatial
    - TestExecBuild/fakedist-spec-planning/geospatial
    
    With explicit casts in this patch, these failures are resolved.
    
    References:
    https://go.dev/ref/spec#Floating_point_operators
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/53297
    https://github.com/golang/go/issues/48145
    https://github.com/disintegration/gift/issues/20#issuecomment-524551797
    
    Co-authored-by: Prashant Khoje <prashant.khoje@ibm.com>
    Co-authored-by: Prashant Khoje <prashant.khoje@gslab.com>

result.response:
I have implemented `Encode` and `Decode` on `ShapeIndex` along with shape encoding/decoding support and input validation, and started running the `s2` test suite in the container. I will inspect the test results once the background test run completes.
I fixed the slice initialization in `Polyline.decode` and the `l.index` initialization order in `Loop.decodeCompressed`, and re-ran the `s2` test suite. I will check the results when the command finishes.
I updated the slice initialization in `ShapeIndex.Decode` so all `ShapeIndex` encoding/decoding tests pass, and started running the full `go test ./...` suite in the container. I will check the results when it finishes.
I have implemented `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` on [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go#L587-L636) and committed all changes on branch `shapeindex-encode-decode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex` Serialization ([s2/shapeindex.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go))**:
  - Added [`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go#L1847-L1906) and [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go#L1909-L2089), preserving `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, shape IDs (including gaps from removed shapes), all indexed shapes, and the full spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, and each cell's `clippedShape` entries with `shapeID`, `containsCenter`, and `edges`).
  - `Encode` calls `s.Build()` first so unbuilt indexes encode completely, and `Decode` marks the index `fresh` so queries and iteration work immediately without `Build()`.
  - Fixed [`applyUpdatesInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go#L838-L877) and [`makeIndexCell`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex.go#L1218-L1288) to iterate and bound sentinels using `s.nextID` rather than `len(s.shapes)` so non-contiguous shape IDs after removals are indexed properly.
  - Added a CRC-32 checksum trailer, bounded initial slice/map capacities, and strict bounds/ordering validation during decoding to return errors without panicking or OOMing on truncated data, corrupted bytes, or oversized allocation requests.
- **Built-in `Shape` Encoding & Decoding**:
  - Added `Encode`/`Decode` and internal encoder/decoder support for [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/point_vector.go#L54-L115), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/lax_polyline.go#L66-L131), [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/lax_loop.go#L97-L160), and [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/lax_polygon.go#L230-L333), plus a generic `Shape` fallback.
  - Fixed `ChainEdge` in [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/point_vector.go#L45) and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/lax_loop.go#L83-L89), `ChainPosition` in [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/lax_polygon.go#L212-L227), and pointer receiver handling in [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/polyline.go#L383-L418).
  - Hardened [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/loop.go#L1289-L1450), [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/polygon.go#L1134-L1228), and [`decodePointsCompressed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/pointcompression.go#L156-L278) against integer overflow, oversized allocations, and invalid coordinates/bounds.
- **Tests ([s2/shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-g9xmcg0v/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L575-L1193))**:
  - Added tests for empty indexes, all built-in `Shape` types, unbuilt indexes, shape ID preservation across removals, zero-edge (empty and full) shapes, mixed chain counts, and malformed inputs (all truncated prefixes, single-byte corruptions across the entire stream, and oversized allocation requests).
